name: "VC Charlie" (the taxi driver)
summary: The Saigon taxi driver Larry and Ron Tototz rode with, named while Larry was looking at VN-0073, boys swimming in the river, taken as he stepped out of a taxi: "The taxi driver's name was VC Charlie or that's what we called him. He knew me and Ronnie Tototz. 90% of the time Ronnie and I rode with VC Charlie. He was a nice guy making a living and always laughing."
researchNotes: Hidden from the people index (a template constant): a nickname, not an identification, and nothing more is known. The joke in the name is the point. He is here because the taxi from the base into the city recurs in Larry's Saigon and a place record needs a way to refer to him. Not searchable, and nothing about him should be put to Larry as a question. First named 2026-09-05 (data/recollections/giscus-vn-0073-c18307950.json). Corrected 2026-09-14 after research/site-audit-2026-09-14.md: this record said Larry named him again at VN-0062, a photograph from a taxi between the base and Saigon; that comment does not name him, and the link from it was removed.
